name: Union Square Market Street Headhouse
note: The north head house of Union Square/Market Street Station on Geary at Stockton, Central Subway 2022: granite pavilion, dark perforated awning over the mouth, glass lift behind Hughen/Starkweather's Convergence art glass, roof terrace. Fitted to way/616479968, the ABOVE-ground structure (building=train_station, building:levels=1) — NOT the list's way/184956226, which is the underground station box. front=180 (not "street"): the entrance node/10185148562's footway link leaves it due south, so the mouth faces Geary.

name: Powell Street Station Canopy
note: The Market & Ellis entrance to Powell Street Station (subway_entrance node/5318198803, BART ref A2), Perkins Eastman's 2018 canopy: a flat champagne plane on four slim columns over frameless glass screens, with the POWELL STREET pylon. STANDALONE, not fitted to way/160331904: that way is the station's UNDERGROUND box (location=underground, 300 m long), which bake.ts drops.
